artboards.title: The head and the attention rail
The open card — its own run; keeps the depth

annotations.text:
Needle UI/UX — a proposal over today's feature set.
The intent: oversight and intuitive control. The one rule underneath everything here: colour is a language of five words, and nothing is coloured for decoration.
Assumed: the current type (Archivo + IBM Plex Mono), the dark palette, 288px columns; everything else is up for grabs.

The open card is its own design run. The owner ruled: keep every layer of depth the card carries today, make the depth easier to scan. This board shows only the top of it — what it is, what is happening, what you can do — and is not the proposal for the rest.
Read left to right, top to bottom: the language first, then the head that speaks it, then the board, the card, the open card, the triage lens.
